definitions: To reach the same point or level as someone or something else after being behind.
To meet someone you know after a period of time and talk about what has been happening.
To punish someone for something wrong they have done.
To have a negative effect on someone at a later time.
examples: She's been ill and is trying to catch up with her schoolwork.
It was good to catch up with you.
The police will catch up with him eventually.
His past mistakes are starting to catch up with him.
pastTenses: caught up with, caught up with
